title: Goldman Sachs, Apple to launch corner credit card: WSJ
text:
Goldman Sachs, Apple to launch corner credit card: WSJ 2018.Saved under Business
(Reuters) – Goldman Sachs ( GS.N ) and Apple Inc ( AAPL.O ) are scheming to launch a corner credit card, a Wall Street Journal reported here on Thursday.
The Goldman Sachs association trademark is seen in a company’s space on a building of a New York Stock Exchange, (NYSE) in New York, U.S., Apr 17, 2018. REUTERS/Brendan McDermid
The designed label would lift a Apple Pay code and could launch early subsequent year, a Journal reported, citing people informed with a matter.
The company’s trademark is seen outward Austria’s initial Apple store, that opens on Feb 24, during a media preview in Vienna, Austria, Feb 22, 2018. REUTERS/Heinz-Peter Bader
The iPhone builder will reinstate a longstanding rewards-card partnership with Barclays ( BARC.L ), a news added.
Goldman Sachs, Apple and Barclays all declined comment.
The news comes as Apple sharpens a concentration on a services business that includes a App Store, mobile payments and song streaming. The unit’s income grew 31 percent to some-more than $9 billion in a 3 months finished Mar 31.
Goldman has been looking to enhance a consumer banking business to equivalent debility during a trade unit. Last year, a Wall Street bank’s executives laid out a idea to beget $5 billion in income from new sources, including consumer banking.
In February, a Wall Street Journal reported that Apple was in talks with Goldman to offer financing to shoppers shopping Apple products, including iPhones.
